decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 30th October 2006, an erection of a single storey rear extension, giving a total volume increase to the original house of 32.36m3, as shown on drawing numbers P06-38, received 30 October 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a single storey rear extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - Informative:
If any part of this development is outside the curtilage of the dwellinghouse, the development will no longer be lawful and planning permission will be required.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear infill extension to house
